verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an identity and authorization platform, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence covers only server-side or adjacent capabilities: the Auth0 MCP Server lets AI tools manage a tenant, and Auth0 for AI Agents secures customers' agents connecting to MCP servers. Neither shows Auth0 itself plugging in MCP servers to use their tools, so the axis does not apply.
